free_text: The patient is a 70-year-old male with a rising PSA of 6.9 ng/mL and a prior biopsy-proven adenocarcinoma with a Gleason score of 4+4 (ISUP grade group 4). MRI revealed a PI-RADS 5 lesion in the right paramedian apex/transition zone, with evidence of restricted diffusion and high vascularity. The clinical T stage is cT1c. Management assessment is pending clinical review regarding individual treatment benefit and patient preferences, balancing potential treatment efficacy against comorbidities.
